animation.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE transparent 4-direction WALK CYCLE sprite sheet for a 2D top-down game. Input image is a STYLE and CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY. Use ONLY the HUMAN EXPLORER in ROW FOUR COLUMN THREE of the reference: charcoal grey sci-fi spacesuit, compact backpack, metallic shoulder armor, cyan glass helmet visor, two arms and two boots. Do NOT include any monsters or other subjects. Make 16 sprites of THIS EXACT SAME explorer character on a square transparent atlas, EXACT 4 columns and 4 rows of equal cells. All 16 have identical armor design, body scale, proportions, camera elevation, head height and foot ground baseline. Each sprite fills the central 65 percent of its cell height, with at least 15 percent transparent margin around every cell. Straight orthographic high three-quarter game view, not isometric. Row 1 ALL face SOUTH toward viewer; row 2 ALL face EAST, character's right profile; row 3 ALL face NORTH, showing back of helmet and backpack, no face visor visible; row 4 ALL face WEST, left profile. In EACH row, columns 1 through 4 are a coherent looping four-phase walk cycle: 1 left leg leading and right arm forward, 2 feet pass close together, 3 right leg leading and left arm forward, 4 opposite passing pose. Real leg motion and opposing arm swing, NOT four duplicate idle poses. Empty hands relaxed; no tools, weapons, shadows or floor. Preserve same camera angle and apparent size in every frame. Baseline at 82 percent cell height for every pose; character centered on 50 percent of cell width. Clear feet silhouettes; head and shoulders stay aligned as legs change. Clean realistic hand-painted game art to match reference. Genuine alpha transparency, NO grid lines, labels, text, checkerboard or background. No sprites crossing cell boundaries.

files.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production terrain texture atlas for an original 2D top-down survival game named Gloamdepths. Generate a square 1024x1024 atlas, EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows of equal 256px square tiles, with absolutely no gutters, borders, labels or text. Each tile completely fills its own square. Orthographic straight-down view, flat repeating surfaces (NO isometric cubes, NO perspective walls). Unified premium hand-painted sci-fi ruin materials, large readable forms and low-frequency texture designed to shrink to 40px tiles. Dark desaturated slate blue and gunmetal with restrained cyan inlays; aged industrial alien archaeology, not cartoon. Tile order left to right row by row: row 1: weathered dark alloy rubble; blue-grey cut stone alloy panels; dark violet obsidian alloy; almost-black indestructible armored bedrock. Row 2: coal black carbon deposit with obvious coal chunks; copper-bearing rock with orange metallic copper chunks; iron-bearing rock with silver metal chunks; gold-bearing rock with luminous warm gold chunks. Row 3: lumite rock with prominent cyan energy crystals; diamond rock with prominent ice blue faceted diamonds; dark empty-space violet rock; softly rippled deep teal water. Row 4: reinforced wooden planks with subtle blue metal brackets; reinforced blue-grey metal wall plate; violet sealed ancient circuit panel; rusted broken machinery tangled with brown roots. Ores are clearly distinct centered deposits embedded in darker rock, not loose inventory icons. Materials only, full bleed opaque background, no lighting outside tiles, no huge blooms, no vignette across whole atlas. Precisely align the 16 square cell boundaries.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent character sprite atlas for the original 2D overhead survival game Gloamdepths. Square 1024x1024 PNG, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, equal square cells, no gutters or visible grid. Genuine alpha transparent background across whole canvas. Sixteen separate whole-body characters each centered in its own cell, each occupies 76 percent of cell, generous transparent margin, no part crosses its cell. Unified high-quality hand-painted 3D game sprite look seen from high overhead three-quarter view with faces toward bottom of image, no floor, no scenery, no drop shadows, no text or labels, no checkerboard. Dark sci-fi archaeological ruins: blue-grey alloy armor, clean big silhouettes readable at 40 pixels, restrained colored power cores, NOT cute round emoji. Row 1 left to right: small agile cyan-eyed four-legged salvage drone (imp); red-eyed armored wolf robot (hunter); squat heavy orange-core drill golem (breaker); mechanical green acid spitting beetle (spitter). Row 2: floating purple tattered hologram wraith (phantom); hovering dark violet energy orb with metal shell (abyss); small red reactor bomb robot with legs (bomber); green bioluminescent fungus mech (spore). Row 3: tall undead blue armored robotic knight (revenant); small crawling purple void parasite robot (voidling); massive ancient steel guardian golem with cyan core and broad shoulders (sentinel); massive orange molten armored guardian (fire boss). Row 4: massive icy silver guardian with ice-blue crystals (frost boss); massive violet ancient void guardian with hornlike angular plating (void boss); HUMAN EXPLORER in a practical charcoal spacesuit with teal visor helmet, shoulder plates, backpack, two distinct arms and boots, unarmed (player); hooded robot merchant in grey cloak carrying amber utility satchel (trader). Balance cell sizes, all 16 distinct characters complete and non-overlapping. True transparency, no ground circles, no decorative frames.
files.layoutCorrectionPrompt: Edit target: this transparent 16-character sprite atlas. Preserve exactly the same 16 character designs, colors, hand-painted realistic sci-fi art style, row order and column order, and transparent background. FIX THE LAYOUT ONLY: rebuild into an EXACT uniform 4 by 4 grid on a square canvas. Every row is precisely 25 percent of total height and every column is precisely 25 percent of total width. SHRINK EACH WHOLE CHARACTER to fit entirely within the central 65 percent of its cell, centered both horizontally and vertically. Leave at least 17.5 percent blank transparent margin on every side of every cell. Especially shrink all golems/bosses so their heads, shoulders, feet and horns have generous margins and cannot touch or cross boundaries. No character fragments can be in any neighboring cell. The player in row 4 column 3 must be complete, with head and both boots and empty transparent space all around. Preserve all 16 sprites but make them distinctly smaller with much more transparent spacing. No gridlines, background, shadows, framing, text or checkerboard.

notes: 64 格原創素材，透過映射支援多種同系列裝備；選取範圍依圖集實際尺寸計算。
使用內建 image_gen 產生；原始檔保留於 Codex generated_images，專案使用本資料夾內副本。
原版素材保留；未覆蓋的物品、動物、寵物與特效仍使用原素材或既有程式繪圖。
同系列裝備共用造型並以色調區分；淵魄君主沿用虛空守衛的造型與變色。
地板與星核保持程序化繪製；玩家新增四方向、每方向四格的行走圖集，攻擊、受擊及怪物動態採程序化回饋。
